capabilities: Detect changes to a tracked frontmatter property
Write a date property named after the new status
Preserve first dates for configurable final statuses
Keep a compact transition history in the note
Choose which property is tracked in settings
disambiguation: It does not display or manage properties; it only writes date properties when a tracked property changes.
extras: Dates always use the device's local ISO format, ignoring Obsidian date-format settings; requires Obsidian 1.10.0 or later; all processing is local with no network requests.
problem: Obsidian does not automatically record when a property value changes, so status transition dates must be maintained by hand.
summary: Plugin that stamps a dated property (YYYY-MM-DD) whenever a tracked frontmatter property, defaulting to status, changes value.
